keyword: did they find the second pilot in iran
claims: According to reports on April 5, 2026, U.S. forces successfully rescued the second crew member, a weapons system officer, of the F-15E fighter jet shot down over Iran.
The first pilot was rescued shortly after the incident.
The second crew member was rescued later in a daring operation.
President Trump announced in a Truth Social post early Sunday morning that the second airman was secured.
The crew was downed over a remote area of Iran by Iranian forces.
The rescue involved elite U.S. special forces in what was described as a high-risk operation.
According to The New York Times, one crew member had injuries.
The F-15E was brought down on Friday, April 3, 2026.
